text_block_list.text:
As the Sprinters Stakes approaches, our
final
preparations begin with our
senior-year summer
camp! As for
Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! It feels good to be back! Oh
yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer! I want this year's training
camp to
be ten billion times tougher
than last year! Let's
blow past my limits!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory

camp yet
